'''Ricardo Baeza Rodríguez''' is a [[Chilean people|Chilean]] [[mathematician]] who works as a professor at the [[University of Talca]].<ref name="ac"/><ref name="talca">{{citation|title=Miembro de Excelencia: Ricardo Baeza será distinguido por la American Mathematical Society|url=http://www.utalca.cl/link.cgi/SalaPrensa/academia/5382|website=Sala de Prensa|publisher=University of Talca|date=November 16, 2012|access-date=2015-01-12}}.</ref> He earned his Ph.D. in 1970 from [[Saarland University]], under the joint supervision of Robert W. Berger and Manfred Knebusch.<ref name="talca"/><ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=58486}}.</ref> His research interest is in [[number theory]].<ref name="lanacion"/>

== Career ==
Baeza became a member of the Chilean Academy of Sciences in 1983.<ref name="ac">[http://www.academia-ciencias.cl/wp/?page_id=388 Member profile], Chilean Academy of Sciences, retrieved 2015-01-12.</ref> He was the 2009 winner of the Chilean [[National Prize for Exact Sciences (Chile)|National Prize for Exact Sciences]].<ref name="talca"/><ref name="lanacion">{{citation|title=Ricardo Baeza gana Premio Nacional de Ciencias Exactas|url=http://www.lanacion.cl/noticias/vida-y-estilo/ricardo-baeza-gana-premio-nacional-de-ciencias-exactas/2009-08-26/222335.html|website=Nacion.cl|date=August 27, 2009}}.</ref> In 2012, he became one of the inaugural [[fellow]]s of the [[American Mathematical Society]], the only Chilean to be so honored.<ref name="talca"/><ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |date=2018-08-25 }}, retrieved 2015-01-12.</ref>

== Research ==
In 1990, Baeza proved the [[norm theorem]] over [[Characteristic (algebra)|characteristic]] two; it had been previously proved in other characteristics.<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |last=Baeza |first=Ricardo |date=1990 |title=The norm theorem for quadratic forms over a field of characteristic 2 |url=http://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/00927879008823968 |journal=Communications in Algebra |language=en |volume=18 |issue=5 |pages=1337–1348 |doi=10.1080/00927879008823968 |issn=0092-7872|url-access=subscription }}</ref> The theorem states that if ''q'' is a nonsingular [[quadratic form]] over a [[Field (mathematics)|field]] ''F'', and <math>\pi(t)\in F[t]</math> be a monic [[irreducible polynomial]] (with <math>F(\pi) := F[t]/\pi(t)</math> the corresponding [[field extension]]), then <math>(\pi(t))\otimes q\cong q</math> if and only if <math>q\otimes F(\pi)</math> is hyperbolic.<ref name=":0" />

In 1992, Baeza and [[Roberto Aravire]] introduced a modification of Milnor's [[k-theory]] for [[quadratic forms]] over a field of characteristic two.<ref name=":1">{{Cite journal |last=Aravire |first=Ricardo |last2=Aravire |first2=Roberto |date=1992 |title=Milnor'ory and quadratic forms over fields of characteristic two |url=http://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/00927879208824393 |journal=Communications in Algebra |language=en |volume=20 |issue=4 |pages=1087–1107 |doi=10.1080/00927879208824393 |issn=0092-7872|url-access=subscription }}</ref> In particular, if <math>W_q(F)</math> denotes the [[Witt group]] of quadratic forms over a field ''F'', then one can construct a group <math>k_n(F)</math> and an [[isomorphism]] <math>s_n : h_n(F) \to I^{n - 1}W_q(F)/I^nW_q(F)</math> for every value of ''n''.<ref name=":1" />

In 2003, Baeza and Aravire studied quadratic forms and [[differential forms]] over certain [[Function field of an algebraic variety|function fields of an algebraic variety]] of characteristic two.<ref name=":2">{{Cite journal |last=Aravire |first=Roberto |last2=Baeza |first2=Ricardo |date=2003 |title=The behavior of quadratic and differential forms under function field extensions in characteristic two |url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S0021869302005689 |journal=Journal of Algebra |language=en |volume=259 |issue=2 |pages=361–414 |doi=10.1016/S0021-8693(02)00568-9|hdl=10533/174037 |hdl-access=free }}</ref> Using this result, they deduced the characteristic two analogue of [[Knebusch's degree conjecture]].<ref name=":2" />

In 2007, Baeza and Arason found a [[group presentation]] of the groups <math>I^n(K)\subset W(K)</math>, generated by ''n''-fold bilinear [[Pfister forms]], and of the groups <math>I^nW_q(K)\subset W_q(K)</math>, generated by quadratic Pfister forms.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Arason |first=Jón Kr. |last2=Baeza |first2=Ricardo |date=August 2007 |title=Relations in I n and I n W q in characteristic 2 |url=https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S0021869307002773 |journal=Journal of Algebra |language=en |volume=314 |issue=2 |pages=895–911 |doi=10.1016/j.jalgebra.2007.05.004|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
